title: Fixed even geometric outer column at index 0
statement: The even geometric outer-column recognition statement specialized to the fixed index 0.

proof.text: Apply the existing single-open stage presentation at shift -1 separately to U and V. Both are compact and contained in the image of t. Map the actual representing cocone through each open restriction/direct-image functor and shifted additive Hom, then ULift. Its underlying canonical group-colimit cocone is a set colimit by filtered-colimit preservation of the forgetful functor, after universe shrinking. The inclusion/desc equation gives the pinning equation. Thus each single-open comparison is basic local-map data. Reuse the proved private localComparison_of_stage_presentation helper from PerfectHomMayerVietorisGeometricColumnsOdd via a proof-only import all, rather than duplicating its theorem and proof.

Project column 0 to the two single-open Hom diagrams via the shifted biproduct projections. Naturality and the cocone equations follow from the prescribed hom2 component of the geometric family and biprod.map_fst/map_snd. The inverse shifted Hom splitting is the sum of the two shifted injections.

The induced map from the column colimit to the product of the local colimits is bijective. For surjectivity, move two stage representatives to a common stage and use the stagewise biproduct splitting. For injectivity, represent two elements at one stage, use eventual equality in each local filtered colimit, then move both equalities to a common later stage. Stagewise injectivity and the cocone laws identify the original elements. Transport the product of the two basic local maps through this source equivalence and the inverse apex splitting. The transport agrees with the original colimit.desc by checking stage representatives.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_geometric_columns_even_zero
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F)
    (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d)
    (A : PerfectHomMVFamily Y (t ⁻¹ᵁ U) (t ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
      PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
        (colimit.desc
          ((A.diagram F h.stageQCoh ⋙ perfectHomTriangleRowFunctor Y P).flip.obj (0 : Fin 5))
          ⟨(perfectHomTriangleRow Y P (A.cocone F d h.stageQCoh h.limitQCoh).pt).obj (0 : Fin 5),
            (perfectHomTriangleRowCoconeMap Y P (A.diagram F h.stageQCoh)
              (A.cocone F d h.stageQCoh h.limitQCoh)).app (0 : Fin 5)⟩)
